# UX Checklist: Speaker-To-Mic Leakage Control

**Purpose**: Validate that user-facing recording truth, non-burden, accessibility, and brand-distance requirements are complete before implementation.
**Created**: 2026-06-04
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are requirements complete for keeping normal recording free of live leakage prompts, route remediation, volume-lowering requests, rerun checks, or technical risk acceptance? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003c, Spec §FR-010b, Spec §SC-017]
- [x] CHK002 Are post-finalization user-facing recording-truth states defined for contaminated, degraded, unproven, not-measured, not-applicable, and derived-cleaned outcomes? [Completeness, Spec §FR-015, Spec §SC-011]
- [x] CHK003 Are requirements complete for preserving visible `Record`/`Stop`, active capture indicator, and one-action stop while adding final recording truth? [Completeness, Spec §FR-016, Constitution §II]
- [x] CHK004 Are requirements defined for explaining derived cleaned tracks without implying that original evidence was overwritten or secretly modified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003b.1, Spec §SC-020]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK005 Is user-facing language required to describe artifact truth in simple terms rather than making the user responsible for audio engineering? [Clarity, Spec §FR-015]
- [x] CHK006 Are live versus post-finalization states clearly separated so users are not shown authoritative leakage truth during recording? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010a, Spec §FR-010b, Plan §Summary]
- [x] CHK007 Is the product behavior clear when built-in speakerphone recordings cannot be proven clean, including what the user sees after finalization? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003a, Spec §SC-015, Quickstart §Scenario 6]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK008 Are UX requirements consistent with "do not burden the user" while still allowing concise after-the-fact recording-truth status? [Consistency, Spec §FR-003c, Spec §FR-015]
- [x] CHK009 Are UX requirements consistent with no hidden recording, visible capture state, and one-action stop? [Consistency, Constitution §II, Spec §FR-016]
- [x] CHK010 Are copy and state requirements consistent with clean-room brand-distance rules and not modeled on Krisp proprietary language or assets? [Consistency, Spec §US5, Spec Constitutional Requirements]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK011 Is the user-burden success criterion measurable for normal recording flows across built-in speakers, headphones, USB, Bluetooth, and aggregate/multi-output routes? [Measurability, Spec §SC-017, Quickstart §Scenario 6]
- [x] CHK012 Are accessibility requirements measurable for any post-finalization status surface, including localization, keyboard reachability, and color-independent communication? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec Constitutional Requirements]
- [x] CHK013 Are recording-truth states measurable without relying on vague terms such as "risky" or "bad" unless those labels map to defined package statuses? [Measurability, Spec §FR-010.1, Spec §FR-015]

## Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK014 Are requirements defined for what the user sees when finalization returns `unproven` versus `not_measured`, so the two states are not collapsed in UX copy? [Coverage, Spec §FR-010.1]
- [x] CHK015 Are requirements defined for after-the-fact explanation when a package is blocked from transcription readiness because of leakage or timeline misalignment? [Coverage, Spec §FR-011, Spec §SC-011]
- [x] CHK016 Are requirements defined for optional derived-track readiness so users can distinguish original evidence truth from derived artifact usability? [Coverage, Spec §FR-010a.1, Spec §SC-020]
